mentions.name: Animal Popper
mentions.description: A casual game about popping animals, where popped animals are collected into a menagerie; failing makes a seagull sick. It includes footballs and tournament-themed content to play along with a current tournament.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a little game about popping animals (mankind’s oldest enemy?) and when you fail, a seagull is sick. The animals you pop go into your menagerie so they are ok (they also aren’t real). Right now it has footballs and such to play along with a current tournament
